$comment: Theme and logo are inherited from deploy/domain-branding.json. Layout follows deploy/visual-mapping.json: highest level top-left, no decorative header band, part-to-whole charts only where they earn their place.

pages.name: Spend vs plan
pages.storyNote: Spend is 4.0% under budget overall, but FY2026 is up 11% on FY2025 and the forecast runs 951K above actuals.

visuals.title: Fiscal year
visuals.altText: Dropdown that filters the page to one fiscal year.

visuals.title: Legal entity
visuals.altText: Dropdown that filters the page to one legal entity.

visuals.title: Actual spend vs budget
visuals.altText: Latest-period actual spend against the budget for the same period, with the trend across all periods and the percentage distance to budget.

visuals.title: Forecast vs actual
visuals.altText: Latest-period forecast against actual spend, showing how far the forecast sits above what was really spent.

visuals.title: Headcount (all snapshots)
visuals.altText: Headcount summed across the monthly snapshots in the current filter; it is a volume total, not a point-in-time count.

visuals.subtext: Every business unit is under budget, yet the forecast still runs about 951K above actual spend. The gap is planning, not overspend.

visuals.title: Forecast runs consistently above actual spend
visuals.altText: Actual spend and forecast by fiscal period. The forecast line stays above the actual line in every period of both fiscal years.

visuals.title: Every business unit is under budget
visuals.altText: Budget variance contributed by each business unit. All contributions are negative, meaning every unit spent less than planned.

visuals.title: FY2026 spend is 11% above FY2025
visuals.altText: Budget and actual spend compared across the two fiscal years.

visuals.title: Cost center detail
visuals.altText: Budget, actual, variance and variance percentage for every cost center, sorted by budget.

pages.name: Workforce & pay
pages.storyNote: Headcount holds around 145 and payroll cost per FTE spans only 3.7% across job families, so pay is consistent rather than skewed.

visuals.title: Fiscal year
visuals.altText: Dropdown that filters the page to one fiscal year.

visuals.title: Legal entity
visuals.altText: Dropdown that filters the page to one legal entity.

visuals.title: Headcount (all snapshots)
visuals.altText: Headcount summed across the monthly snapshots in the current filter.

visuals.title: Total compensation
visuals.altText: Total annualised compensation across all employees in the current filter.

visuals.title: Payroll cost per FTE
visuals.altText: Average annualised payroll cost for one full-time equivalent.

visuals.subtext: Cost per FTE spans 93.6K to 97.1K across the six job families, a 3.7% range. No family is an outlier.

visuals.title: Headcount is stable across both fiscal years
visuals.altText: Headcount by fiscal period, drifting between 142 and 146 with no step change.

visuals.title: Pay per FTE varies only 3.7% across job families
visuals.altText: Payroll cost per full-time equivalent for each job family, sorted from highest to lowest.

visuals.title: Overtime stays a marginal share of worked hours
visuals.altText: Overtime hours as a share of worked hours, by fiscal period.

visuals.title: Compensation by job family
visuals.altText: Total compensation and cost per full-time equivalent for each job family.

pages.name: Talent pipeline
pages.storyNote: 30 candidates applied and 12 reached offer stage; sourcing is split evenly across the three channels.

visuals.title: Fiscal year
visuals.altText: Dropdown that filters the page to one fiscal year.

visuals.title: Offers made

visuals.title: Offer acceptance rate

visuals.title: Open requisitions
visuals.altText: Number of requisitions still open.

visuals.subtext: Only 30 candidates entered the funnel and 4 offers were made across the year. Volume, not conversion, is the constraint.

visuals.title: Candidate funnel: 30 applied, 12 reached offer
visuals.altText: Candidates remaining at each recruitment stage, from applied through screened, interviewed, offer and closed.

visuals.title: Sourcing is split evenly across the three channels
visuals.altText: Candidate count by sourcing channel: agency, direct and referral each contribute the same volume.

visuals.title: Offers are sparse: 4 across four periods
visuals.altText: Offers extended per fiscal period; only four periods record an offer, one each.
